visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a short dark bob haircut and expressive eyes smiles warmly at the camera. She wears a white off-the-shoulder knit top and stands in a bright indoor living room. She holds a smartphone showing the LINE Pay app. Behind her are a grey sofa, a large green potted plant, and a warm-toned floor lamp against a white brick wall. (2) The visual shifts to a close-up of a hand holding a phone to scan a QR code on a green payment terminal. Various graphic text overlays in white and green appear, explaining payment differences and digital wallet features while the woman remains the focal point in smaller inset shots or through voiceover. (3) A series of screen recordings and digital graphics show the app's version requirements (4.9.0 and 15.18). The interface is clean, with dark backgrounds and highlighted text markers in white circles to guide the viewer through the menu settings. (4) Step-by-step registration screens are shown, covering identity selection (Taiwan ID vs. Resident Certificate), SMS verification, and personal information input. The shots are primarily screen captures of a mobile device with quick transitions between steps. (5) A transition graphic explains the migration from iPASS Money to LINE Pay Money. The woman returns to the full frame, gesturing with her hands while explaining the final steps of setting an ID and password. (6) The video concludes with the woman back in the living room setting, speaking enthusiastically with varied hand gestures to summarize the benefits. Bold yellow and white captions with green outlines emphasize her points as she points toward the camera for a call-to-action.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: LINE Pay Money 正式上線啦！ [Variety]: LINE Pay Money. (2) [Subtitle]: 不知道怎麼開通. (3) [Subtitle]: 我來教你！ (4) [Subtitle]: 首先先講最大的差別 LINE Pay 只能刷信用卡. [Slogan]: LINE Pay. (5) [Subtitle]: 但是 LINE Pay Money 是電子錢包！ [Slogan]: LINE Pay Money. (6) [Subtitle]: 可以儲值、可以轉帳、可以收款. [Variety]: 全新 LINE Pay Money 現在就來體驗！ (7) [Subtitle]: 要開通記得要先確認版本更新到 4.9.0 以上. (8) [Subtitle]: LINE App 則需要更新到 15.18 以上. (9) [Subtitle]: 進到 LINE Pay 點擊立即開通 LINE Pay Money. (10) [Subtitle]: 選擇使用台灣身分證或居留證開通. (11) [Subtitle]: 收簡訊準備身分證驗證. (12) [Subtitle]: 是用銀行帳戶照填就好. (13) [Subtitle]: 接下來再填寫 LINE Pay Money 帳戶 ID. (14) [Subtitle]: 設定好密碼就完成囉. (15) [Subtitle]: 那原本的 iPASS Money 呢. (16) [Subtitle]: 它會在年底前轉移完成. (17) [Subtitle]: 你下載 iPASS Money App 還是看得到餘額喔. (18) [Subtitle]: 只是之後如果要 LINE Pay 轉帳給朋友. (19) [Subtitle]: 就必須用 LINE Pay Money 或者 LINE Bank 才可以喔. (20) [Subtitle]: 那開通之後你就可以儲值轉帳收款找店家優惠. (21) [Subtitle]: 也可以用智慧手錶支付喔. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tutorial designed to guide users through the activation of the new 'LINE Pay Money' service. By combining a friendly direct-to-camera address with step-by-step screen recordings, the creator simplifies a technical registration process, emphasizing the benefits of the new digital wallet features compared to standard credit card payments.
